name: arnfar-ai
description: Arnfar AI — Lao accounting RAG + dataset platform (local-first, offline-capable)

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:templates
scripts.lint: biome check . && ./scripts/py.sh ruff check . && ./scripts/py.sh ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && ./scripts/py.sh ruff check --fix . && ./scripts/py.sh ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && bun run typecheck:py
scripts.typecheck:py: cd services/lao-nlp && ../../scripts/py.sh mypy --config-file ../../pyproject.toml app && cd ../docx-extractor && ../../scripts/py.sh mypy --config-file ../../pyproject.toml app
scripts.test:py: cd services/lao-nlp && ../../scripts/py.sh pytest -c ../../pyproject.toml tests && cd ../docx-extractor && ../../scripts/py.sh pytest -c ../../pyproject.toml tests
